annotation.title_clean: Council Regulation amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 as regards an EuroHPC initiative for start-ups to boost European leadership in trustworthy Artificial Intelligence
annotation.title_en: Council Regulation amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1173 as regards an EuroHPC initiative for start-ups to boost European leadership in trustworthy Artificial Intelligence
annotation.summary_en: Corrigendum to the Commission's proposal for a Council Regulation amending the EuroHPC Joint Undertaking Regulation to add AI Factories: AI-dedicated supercomputers giving startups access to train trustworthy AI models. Robotics and automated driving are mentioned only as strategic application areas.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds a new EuroHPC objective to develop and operate AI Factories
Defines AI-dedicated supercomputer and AI Factory
Union funds up to 50% of acquisition and operating costs of AI supercomputers
Access limited to proposals for trustworthy, ethical AI in line with EU values, with dedicated startup access
Allows upgrading existing EuroHPC supercomputers with AI capabilities
